series.title: The long-press menu
series.sub: Hold the bar for the actions you use most

steps.title: Hold the tab
steps.text: Keep your finger on the Dock until the ring closes. The menu opens beside it, and stays when you let go.

steps.title: Tap an action
steps.text: Each tile runs its action and the menu closes. Here, the flashlight comes on.

steps.title: Hold and drag to move it
steps.text: Hold, then move instead of letting go: the menu steps aside and the bar follows your finger.

steps.title: Open its settings
steps.text: In Gesture Volume, under Advanced features, tap Long-press menu. The preview shows the menu as it is.

steps.title: Choose the actions
steps.text: Open Items: remove what you never use, and add what you want from Available. Here, Screenshot in place of Stop service.

steps.title: Pick a panel style
steps.text: Under Colours, choose how it is drawn. Glass blurs what is behind it; the Deck and the Quick slider use the same style.

steps.title: Choose how it opens
steps.text: Under Animation, pick an opening animation. The preview plays it each time you pick one.

steps.title: Hold the tab again
steps.text: Your actions, in the style and animation you picked.
